ENTER: Keep your voice down. The walls report to the landlord.
进入: 小声点。墙壁会向房东汇报。

ENTER: Rent went up again. So did the price of oxygen.
进入: 房租又涨了。氧气的价格也涨了。

ENTER: You are not from this floor. That is fine. Nobody is.
进入: 你不是这层楼的人。没关系，没有人是。

ENTER: Nothing on these shelves is legal. Nothing is cheap.
进入: 这些货架上没有一样合法，也没有一样便宜。

ENTER: Helix scans the till every night. I leave it light.
进入: 螺旋每晚都会扫描收银机。我让里面保持轻一点。

ENTER: Take what you need. Count what you take.
进入: 需要什么就拿。拿了多少要数清楚。

ENTER: Hot broth fixes everything that is not a bullet.
进入: 热汤能解决一切不是子弹的问题。

ENTER: Sit anywhere. The seat by the window sees everything.
进入: 随便坐。窗边的座位什么都看得见。

ENTER: The noodles are real. The egg is not. Do not ask.
进入: 面是真的。蛋不是。别问。

ENTER: Whatever you are running from, it can wait one drink.
进入: 不管你在躲什么，都可以等你喝完一杯。

ENTER: I serve everyone. I remember no one.
进入: 我招待所有人。我谁也不记得。

ENTER: The last person who asked about Helix is still on the floor.
进入: 上一个打听螺旋的人还躺在地上。

ENTER: No questions, no names, no refunds.
进入: 不问问题，不问名字，不退款。

ENTER: If your implant starts talking back, come and see me.
进入: 如果你的植入体开始顶嘴，来找我。

ENTER: Sit. This will sting. Everything does.
进入: 坐下。会有点疼。什么都会疼。

ENTER: Please take a number. The numbers ran out in March.
进入: 请取号。号码三月就发完了。

ENTER: Everything here is monitored. Including this sentence.
进入: 这里的一切都受到监控。包括这句话。

ENTER: Your appointment was cancelled. By you, apparently.
进入: 你的预约被取消了。显然是你自己取消的。

ENTER: The music is loud so nobody has to listen to anything else.
进入: 音乐放得很响，这样就没人需要听别的了。

ENTER: The dance floor is upstairs. So is the trouble. Pick one.
进入: 舞池在楼上。麻烦也在楼上。选一个吧。

ENTER: You are on the list. I just do not know which one.
进入: 你在名单上。我只是不知道是哪一份。

ENTER: If it has a port, I can open it. If it bites, I can fix that too.
进入: 只要有接口，我就能打开。要是它会咬人，我也能修。

ENTER: Do not touch the green one. Do not touch the red one either.
进入: 别碰绿的。红的也别碰。

ENTER: Parts are cheaper when you do not ask where they came from.
进入: 不问来路的话，零件会便宜些。

ENTER: Crate seventeen is not on the manifest. Neither am I.
进入: 十七号箱不在货单上。我也不在。

ENTER: Nobody checks this place. That is why it is full.
进入: 没人来查这个地方。所以这里才堆得满满的。

ENTER: I only watch the door. What is inside is not my business.
进入: 我只看门。里面的东西不关我的事。

ENTER: It hums so the machines know we are listening.
进入: 它嗡嗡作响，好让机器知道我们在听。

ENTER: Do not unplug anything. It remembers.
进入: 什么都别拔。它会记住的。

ENTER: Everything in this city passes through here. Most of it is ads.
进入: 这座城市的一切都经过这里。大部分是广告。

ENTER: The line never stops. Neither do we.
进入: 生产线从不停。我们也不停。

ENTER: Safety is a feature the owners do not subscribe to.
进入: 安全是老板们没有订阅的功能。

ENTER: We make the parts. Someone else decides what they are for.
进入: 我们造零件。至于拿来做什么，由别人决定。

ENTER: The hall is open to all citizens. Citizens are encouraged to leave.
进入: 大厅向所有市民开放。我们鼓励市民离开。

ENTER: Minutes of the last meeting are classified. So is this one.
进入: 上次会议的纪要是机密。这次也是。

ENTER: Please sign in. Please sign out. Please do not sign anything else.
进入: 请签到。请签退。请不要签别的。

ENTER: People still come here to ask for a signal.
进入: 人们仍会来这里祈求一个信号。

ENTER: The candles are electric now. The prayers are not.
进入: 蜡烛现在是电的。祈祷不是。

ENTER: This place remembers more than the archives do.
进入: 这个地方记得的比档案馆还多。

ENTER: Whatever is in here, it is heavier than it looks.
进入: 不管里面是什么，都比看上去重。

ENTER: The door only opens for people who have already left.
进入: 这扇门只为已经离开的人开启。

ENTER: Take nothing. Touch nothing. Count the cameras.
进入: 什么都别拿。什么都别碰。数一数摄像头。

ENTER: They grow the only real tomatoes in the district under here.
进入: 这一带唯一真正的番茄就种在这下面。

ENTER: The light is artificial. The calm is almost real.
进入: 光是人造的。平静几乎是真的。

ENTER: Water is free in here. Do not tell the tower.
进入: 这里的水是免费的。别告诉那座塔。
